Subject:- Benefit of two years weightage of service to the members with 20 or more years
of Pensionable Service under Employees’ Pension Scheme, 1995 — reg.
Sir,

Several references have been received from the field offices that cases where two years
weightage was given where the past service comes out to 20 years, the new application software
while generating the worksheet has reduced the past service benefits in comparison to that calculated

in legacy software. The matter has been examined and the following clarification is issued.
The provision for the past service pension is provided in Para 12 (3) as under :-
S.No. Years of past service Salary upto Salary more
Rs.2500/- per than
month Rs.2500/-
per month
is Upto 11 years 80 85
ii. More than 11 years but 95 105
upto 15 years
iii. More than 15 years but 120 135
less than 20 years
iv. Beyond 20 years 150 170 |

From the above said table it is clear that:
e Row-1 includes past service upto 11 years and 11 years.
¢ — Row-2 includes past service of more than 11 years and upto 15 years and 15 years.
¢  Row-3 includes past service of more than 15 years but less than 20 years.
e Row-4 includes past service beyond 20 years.

As Row-3 specifically speaks of past service less than 20 years, it will not include past service
of 20 years as per simple understanding. Hence, the logical conclusion is that Row-4 will include past
service of 20 years and beyond 20 years.

In this regard necessary changes have been made in the application software by the I.S.
Division and the WAR has been released to all field offices.

In light of the above, it is requested to take necessary action to dispose off all
references/grievances pending at your end.

(This issues with the approval of CPFC)
